tmux new-session -d -s vm "qemu-system-x86_64 -m 2048 -cdrom /app/alpine.iso -boot d -netdev user,id=n0,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -device e1000,netdev=n0 -display curses"; sleep 5; tmux ls; tmux capture-pane -pt vm | tail -40

sleep 30; tmux capture-pane -pt vm | tail -60
